name: Hayden McLachlan
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
description: therapy for the "i'm fine, thanks" crowd. ​i know it’s easy to keep up the mask—saying "i'm fine" or "yeah, not too bad" while carrying the heavy stuff alone. my goal is to create a space where you can move past that and talk about what's actually going on. ​as a younger practitioner, of the spiritual sort, i provide a calm and steady presence for men navigating the weight of modern life. i’m less interested in clinical jargon and more interested in the person sitting next to me. i specialize in helping men navigate the big questions of identity , how we relate to others , and career anxiety , as well as the unique challenges of addiction . ​we use evidence-based tools because they work, but the process is simple: just a proper conversation to propel you forward. not too much clinical talk—just a steady and listening hand to help you find your way through. when are you free? send me an email or text and let's chat. email: hayden@helpercounselling.au phone: 0405 687 918

name: Heather King
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
description: I offer a compassionate, non-judgemental space for you to talk about what’s on your mind. As our body, mind and soul are all intertwined, I take a wholistic approach to give you the best chance of moving through your concerns and reaching your goals. Things I can help with: Anxiety and depression / low mood Work stress: work-life balance, bullying, finding meaning in your work life Loss and grief: impending or actual loss of a person, pet, job, or home, and less-visible losses, such as those that accompany a serious illness or injury Life transitions: new relationship, new baby, entering/leaving the workforce, children leaving home, parents (or yourself) going into care Exploring new directions you want to take or changes you want to make Visit my website to request a free, no-obligation 15-minute phone call to see if I might be the right counsellor for you: https://heatherkingcounselling.com.au/

name: Irene Quintavalle
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 3)
description: Irene’s approach to therapy is deeply empathetic, relational, and attuned to each person’s unique experience. Drawing on her lived experience of trauma, attachment disturbances, and migration challenges, in her private practice, she supports people to heal deep wounds, cultivate meaningful relationships, and navigate life’s transitions within the safety of a therapeutic container. Grounded in Integrative Psychotherapy, Irene has enriched her practice through certifications in Integrative Attachment Therapy and further training in C-PTSD, Mentalisation-Based Techniques, Interpersonal therapies, Sensorimotor Psychotherapy, and EMDR.

name: Jane Steel
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
description: I am a counsellor offering a safe, supportive space for individuals, seeking understanding, healing and meaningful change. I primarily work with women, men and young people who feel the need for support for their trauma, grief, and challenges related to attachment and interpersonal relationships. My approach is compassionate, collaborative, and grounded in the belief that healing happens within a trusting therapeutic relationship.

name: Jaya Narayan
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 4)
description: I am a body-oriented and neurobiology-affirming based trauma therapist. I specialise in trauma-informed-bottom-up frameworks to support anyone experiencing the impact of complex trauma, chronic Stress/ pain, anxiety and burnout. I relationally attune to intersects the wisdom of expressive art(s), Psychodrama, somatics and group processes, allowing a whole body/ brain approach to therapeutic engagement.

name: Jeanette Dvorak
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
description: I am a wellness coach & counsellor dedicated to guiding individuals and groups towards achieving optimal health and well-being. Utilizing an integrative approach, my mission is to empower others to be their best self. I help people make informed and sustainable lifestyle choices that nurture their physical, mental, and emotional wellness.
